name: LocoTrack
plain: LocoTrack (Cho et al., ECCV 2024): track any point through a whole video offline: a per-frame match from a cost volume, then refinement with local 4-D correlation and a transformer over the frames of each track. Apache-2.0 code and weights.
summary: LocoTrack (Cho et al., ECCV 2024): tracking any point offline over a whole video, TAPIR-like with local 4D correlation. A ResNet encodes every 256 x 256 frame at three resolutions; two cost volumes against the query's features give the initial position, visibility and uncertainty; then four refinements correlate the 7 x 7 neighbourhood of each track point with the 7 x 7 support of its query (a 4D correlation, encoded by small convs) and a transformer with ALiBi attention over the frames of each track corrects the whole track at once.

papers.title: Local All-Pair Correspondence for Point Tracking

limitations: Offline: the whole video is encoded before tracking (features of every frame in memory, about 7 MB per frame in float32); for live video use an online tracker (TAPNext, Track-On2).
Frames are resized to 256 x 256 (the training size and that of upstream's TAP-Vid numbers), whatever their size and aspect ratio. Upstream's higher-resolution refinement is not ported.
One video per call; all queries of a call share the video.
task_io: Input: a video (its frames in order) and query points `(t, x, y)`. Output: the position of every query in every frame and the probability that it is visible there.

quality.title: TAP-Vid DAVIS (query first), every 3rd video, AJ / delta_avg / OA %
quality.protocol: TAP-Vid protocol: frames resized to 256 x 256 (PIL Lanczos) before the model (AllTracker: the original frames, resized by the model), one query per track at its first visible point, tracked online (TAPNext, Track-On) or over the whole clip (TAPIR, AllTracker, LocoTrack); AJ, delta_avg (< 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 px at 256 x 256) and occlusion accuracy averaged over the videos.
